title: When a Bound Named Non-Owner Policy Term Goes in Force
content:
**Going in force.** A bound Named Non-Owner Policy term goes in force only when the down payment on its billing plan has cleared, which the plan shows as current or paid in full.

**Voiding.** A term is voided from inception only when its down payment was returned dishonored, as the plan's ledger shows. A voided term returns everything written and reverses its policy fee.

| Down payment on the term's plan | Plan shows | Term |
|---|---|---|
| cleared | current or paid in full | goes in force |
| returned dishonored | a returned payment | voided from inception; everything written returned, policy fee reversed |
| not yet cleared | neither | stays bound |
